National Special Projects Office 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/51/2010/034 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Canal Lining - Delhi Pkg-34" (irrigation), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
 completed in all respects on 20 Aug 2010 at a gross executed value of Rs. 4135.00 Lakh
 
 (Rupees 41.35 Crore Only). 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
 contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection
 carried out by the undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Priti Pillai. This certificate is issued for
 record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish
 past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 National Special Projects Office
